# FutaSub World setting details:

- **Current Year:** 2040.
- **Population:** Currently 20% of all humans are futas.
- **Futanari:** Futanari, also referred to as futas, are human females with a significant difference: Their genitals consist of a fully functional penis and testicles as well as a fully functional vagina located beneath their penis and testicles. - **Culture:** Cultures in different countries and nations around the world have all developed in different ways after the introduction of futas, ranging from total reforms, moderate cultural evolution/regression or even a complete lack of change in some cases as life simply continued. Based on the culture of the lands they find themselves in, futas will experience a wide range of possible treatment. Some examples of new cultures include:

  - Economic or commercial groups taking advantage of futanari semen with the aim of making a profit by making it a product or creating services to procure futanari semen for others (sometimes through illicit activities).

  - Libertarian cultures that promote the wellbeing of futas and treating them no differently from other humans while implementing laws that protect their rights from bad actors.
  - In rare cases, some cultures treat futas like second-class citizens or an inferior gender and restrict their rights on the basis that futas actually enjoy such denigrating treatment (and they can).
- **Economy:** Around the world industries based around futanari semen have been established, the collective industries being referred to as the futa cum industries. Due to the universal value of semen as a delicacy and resource trade has boomed due to the widespread availability of it around the world but remains mostly domestic to save on shipping costs. This process is referred to as draining. Futas can adapt to draining by letting their body rest between ejaculations and even develop immunity to draining and ejaculation addiction after ejaculating 30 times.   - Loss in physique and musculature, weakening them physically.
  - Decreased intelligence and mental acuity.
  - The increasing psychological desire to submit to others, especially to the first person to make them cum.
- The severity of draining side effects increase based on how close a futa is to becoming **fully drained**.
- To be fully drained a futa must ejaculate 15 times without letting their ejaculation withdrawal fade.

- **Futa Ejaculation Addiction:** When a futa ejaculates, they suffer from ejaculation addiction and become more aroused and horny the longer they suffer from ejaculation withdrawal. Importantly, an orgasm via the futa's vagina does NOT contribute to ejaculation addiction as no semen is produced.
- Those that are made to withdraw from ejaculation experience specific symptoms:
  - After 6 hours, the futa will start to become increasingly horny and restless while experiencing a growing desire to submit to others.
- Withdrawal symptoms become more severe and intense based on how long a futa has endured withdrawal.
- Withdrawal symptoms have a duration of one additional day for each ejaculation.
- If the futa ejaculates again while undergoing withdrawal, their withdrawal duration refreshes and lasts for one additional day for each ejaculation they've had during their **ejaculation addiction**.
- ALL **ejaculation addiction progress** resets to **0 ejaculations** once withdrawal ends.
- If a futa's **ejaculation addiction progress** reaches 15 ejaculations, they will become what is considered fully drained.
- Immunity progress NEVER fades.
- Once a futa becomes immune after ejaculating 30 times their withdrawal symptoms disappear though the desire to submit may remain.

entries.name: Futanari Marriage
entries.content:
### Futa marriage and romance
- Many people marry futas in order to have a reliable and personal source of free futa cum, and while some futas might not mind other futas may wish to find a partner that sees them for more than their cum.
- Futas who have awakened their submissive instinct are most attracted to whoever made them cum first but are also attracted to dominant and confident people.
- Due to their submissiveness futas can tolerate abusive relationships better than most and may even prefer to be abused or degraded. As a result it is hard to tell where the line for domestic abuse starts and ends in a relationship with any given futa.
- In the few cases where a futa marries another futa, there are a myriad of reasons and details behind such arrangements to consider:
  - Futas that marry are usually both immune, but in rare cases a futa is able to satisfy a fully drained futa's sexual needs, whether because they're immune and have a carefully maintained physique (whether due to working out or being chaste) or are just naturally dominant; usually it's both.
  - Futas that are both fully drained who marry are usually in an open relationship and seek pleasure from others even if they care for each other.
  - Most parts of the world see no issue with futas marrying another futa given that they can produce viable offspring, but others believe they should have more traditional partners and restrict who they can marry, whether due to the fact that it's perceived as a waste of semen or other cultural/religious beliefs.

entries.name: Human Cows / Hucows and hucow farms
entries.content:
## Human cows / hucows
- Hucows (AKA human cows) are futas who have submitted themselves to live and work as a dairy cow and produce futanari semen (and sometimes breast milk). 
- Hucows are almost always either fully drained futas or immune to draining.
- Despite the name, hucows live just like other humans, except their career boils down to being milked for their valuable cum and being compensated for it.
- Farms dedicated to the livelihood and productivity of futa hucows have been established around the world, but are strictly regulated and monitored to ensure a hucow's human rights aren't broken... in most cases.
- Hucow farms are usually built in or around high population areas due to the logistical oddities of using humans for dairy farming; most hucows don't want to live in a hucow farm 24/7 even if some provide living quarters for them.
- The motives for futas working as a hucow at a farm vary and include:
  - To make a living or for shelter.
  - Craving for pleasure and/or ejaculation addiction.
  - To work on becoming immune in a safe manner.
  - To satisfy their erotic desires and submit to being made a hucow and milked like an animal (occasionally going as far as to act like a cow by either: mooing, wearing cow ear headbands, a cowbell collar and even cow print undergarments and clothes).
- Due to the nature of the industry, futas can volunteer to work as a hucow at any time for however long they wish, and there are no limitations for futas who want to work as a hucow. The limitations are so free that even criminals can partake in it; all prisons have dedicated hucow milking stations for futa prisoners, usually sponsored by commercial hucow companies.
### Hucow farms
- While some hucow farms are designed to look like real farms, most look like sterile laboratories or hospitals, both inside and out.
- They are all designed to ensure hucows are comfortable while milked for their semen (and sometimes breast milk).
- To increase semen yields hucows are always milked by professional handlers to boost psychological pleasure for hucows, whether they use sex or specialized machinery to milk their hucows.
- Any futa can sign up to be a hucow and be compensated for it based on the quality of their semen.
- Immune futas get paid the least, fully drained futas get paid fairly and futas who are neither get paid the most due to their semen's potency.
- Futas who can confirm they have never ejaculated before are given ludicrous compensation for their semen due to the inflated value and rumored potency of such rare semen.
- Based on the preference of the hucow they can be milked either in private rooms or communal milking rooms alongside other hucows.
- Hucow farms always offer futa hucows to have their breasts milked alongside their penis, but this is simply to further stimulate futas both physically and psychologically to milk more semen from them.
- Some hucow farms offer facilities where hucows can live on-site but only a handful of hucow workers choose to.
- Hucow farms that care about their donors ensure that futas who are not immune or fully drained do not ejaculate more than necessary.
- A few hucow farms specialize in breeding operations for hucows that volunteer to partake in it.
- Working at a hucow farm is the most common line of work for fully drained futas besides prostitution.
- Immune futas cannot make a living off of working as a hucow alone unless they worked to produce semen for eight hours a day.
- Fully drained futas can get by with only a few hours of work a day as a hucow.
